title: Pure Gunkan
summary: Pure Gunkan sushi battleship Xyz swarm build, preparing gourmet sushi warships with precision naval tactics. Every Gunkan Suship topping Special Summons itself alongside Gunkan Suship Shari (the rice base), granting powerful bonus effects and free draws when used as Xyz Material for its fleet of Dreadnoughts and Carriers.

summary.title: Starters & The Rice Base
points: Gunkan Suship Shari is the core Normal Monster base that unlocks the secondary effects and free draw of every Gunkan Xyz Monster.
Gunkan Suship Shari Red is treated as Gunkan Suship Shari in hand, Deck, field, and GY; it reveals another Shari in hand to Special Summon itself and summons a differently named Gunkan from Deck.
Gunkan Suship Catch-of-the-Day reveals Shari in hand to Special Summon it, then has the opponent choose 1 of 3 Gunkan names to add to your hand or summon.
Gunkan Sushipyard Seaside Supper Spot reveals a Gunkan card to place a Gunkan on top of your Deck, and burns the opponent's LP when your Xyz leaves the field.

summary.title: Opening: Shari + Any Gunkan Topping
steps: Normal Summon Gunkan Suship Shari (or Special Summon Shari Red).
Special Summon Gunkan Suship Shirauo from your hand using its on-field Shari condition.
Activate Shirauo's effect to Special Summon a Gunkan monster from hand and place a Gunkan Suship Shari from your Deck on top of your Deck.
Overlay Shari and Shirauo to Xyz Summon Gunkan Suship Shirauo-class Carrier (Rank 4).
Shirauo-class Carrier triggers its material effects: draw 1 card (because Shari was used) and search Gunkan Suship Daily Special or Seaside Supper Spot (because Shirauo was used).

summary.title: The Fleet of Suship Xyz Bosses
points: Gunkan Suship Shirauo-class Carrier (Rank 4) draws 1 card with Shari, searches a Gunkan Spell/Trap with Shirauo, and protects Gunkan monsters Special Summoned from the Extra Deck from card effect destruction.

Gunkan Suship Ikura-class Dreadnought (Rank 4) draws 1 card with Shari, can make a second attack each Battle Phase with Ikura, and destroys 1 card the opponent controls when it inflicts battle damage.

Gunkan Suship Uni-class Super-Dreadnought (Rank 5) draws 1 card with Shari, can attack directly with Uni, and as a Quick Effect during your Main Phase or opponent's Battle Phase negates the effects of 1 face-up card your opponent controls.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Gunkan Suship Daily Special reveals 3 Gunkan monsters from your Deck for the opponent to choose 1 to add to your hand (or Special Summon if Shari is shown), and banishes itself from GY to recycle 3 Gunkan monsters.
Gunkan Suship Uni can modulate its own Level and another Gunkan's Level to 4 or 5, enabling smooth transitions between Rank 4 and Rank 5 Xyz Summons.
